provenance.source_version: Dryad DOI 10.5061/dryad.p042h0c, version 23134; every file verified against frozen size and MD5 before inspection
provenance.0_usambara.R: SpatialPoints(ptsE[,3:4]) and SpatialPoints(ptsW[,3:4]) use Nodes_E/W columns 3-4, whose verified headers are centroid_long and centroid_lat; points are rasterized directly onto verified EPSG:4326 rasters without reprojection
provenance.1_sites.R: Sites.csv is joined to Nodes-derived isolation data by region, name, and patch_number; node patch size is Area_ha and the joined site table retains Sites.csv area_ha
provenance.2_isolation_occurrence: spp_occur.csv is grouped by species, joined to site_covars by name, modeled with occur as the binary response and log10(area_ha) as patch area
provenance.Sites.csv: verified headers: region, name, patch_number, centroid_lat, centroid_long, area_m, area_ha, perimeter_m, nearest_fragment, nearest_lg_fragment, distance1, distance2; 14 unique rows
provenance.spp_occur.csv: verified long-form headers: species, forestDependent, understory, name, occur, abund; 1246 rows = 89 species x 14 sites; occur is binary
provenance.Nodes_E.csv: verified columns 3-4 are centroid_long and centroid_lat; 42 unique patch nodes; all nine East study sites match node name, patch_number, and coordinates exactly
provenance.Nodes_W.csv: verified columns 3-4 are centroid_long and centroid_lat; 42 unique patch nodes; all five West study sites match node name, patch_number, and coordinates exactly
provenance.raster_east3.tif: verified raster CRS EPSG:4326, 30 m-equivalent angular cell size 0.0002904315425536523 degrees, all mapped East sites/nodes contained
provenance.raster_west3.tif: verified raster CRS EPSG:4326, 30 m-equivalent angular cell size 0.00029043154255365224 degrees, all mapped West sites/nodes contained
provenance.coordinate_crs: EPSG:4326 is supported jointly by verified raster metadata, centroid_long/centroid_lat field names, direct rasterization in 0_usambara.R, and exact site-to-node coordinate identity
